unresolved_findings: Microsoft .NET Library section 3.a.ii end-user/distributor protective terms and indemnification require owner/legal review; bundling the exact terms does not demonstrate compliance.

Windows SDK UCRT license section 3.a.ii has protective end-user/distributor terms and indemnification obligations; exact package licenseUrl material is retained, but satisfaction and REDIST list association require owner/legal review.

Historical sqlite3.dll has no exact distribution hash match; CPython selectors name SQLite 3.50.4.0, but version metadata alone does not establish the published binary source. VCRUNTIME140/140_1 match official CPython distributions but their separate Microsoft grant/terms still need confirmation.
